def runge_kutta_fehlberg(f, y0, t_span, tol=1e-6, h_init=0.1):
    """
    Adaptive RK45 (Runge-Kutta-Fehlberg) with step size control
    """
    t = [t_span[0]]
    y = [y0.copy()]
    h = h_init
    
    while t[-1] < t_span[1]:
        if t[-1] + h > t_span[1]:
            h = t_span[1] - t[-1]
        
        # TODO: Compute RK45 coefficients
        tn, yn = t[-1], y[-1]
        k1 = h * f(tn, yn)
        k2 = h * f(tn + h/4, yn + k1/4)
        k3 = h * f(tn + 3*h/8, yn + 3*k1/32 + 9*k2/32)
        k4 = h * f(tn + 12*h/13, yn + 1932*k1/2197 - 7200*k2/2197 + 7296*k3/2197)
        k5 = h * f(tn + h, yn + 439*k1/216 - 8*k2 + 3680*k3/513 - 845*k4/4104)
        k6 = h * f(tn + h/2, yn - 8*k1/27 + 2*k2 - 3544*k3/2565 + 1859*k4/4104 - 11*k5/40)
        
        # TODO: 4th and 5th order solutions
        y4 = yn + 25*k1/216 + 1408*k3/2565 + 2197*k4/4104 - k5/5
        y5 = yn + 16*k1/135 + 6656*k3/12825 + 28561*k4/56430 - 9*k5/50 + 2*k6/55
        
        # TODO: Error estimate and step size control
        error = np.linalg.norm(y5 - y4)
        if error < tol:
            t.append(tn + h)
            y.append(y5)
        
        # Adjust step size
        h = h * min(2.0, max(0.1, 0.9 * (tol / error)**0.2))
    
    return np.array(t), np.array(y)
